title: Overlapping Windows

story.briefing: Maintenance windows have been requested all over the Core, and many collide. Approve as many as possible, given that two overlapping windows cannot both run.
story.success: Schedule approved. The maximum number of crews get their slot.

description: Given a list of requested windows, each a two-element array [start, end] with start strictly less than end, return the largest number of them that can be approved so that no two approved windows overlap. Two windows that merely touch — one ending exactly when another starts — do not overlap. An empty list returns 0.
hints: Some order lets you decide each window as you meet it, without ever reconsidering. Think about which window you would always be safe taking first.
Choosing the earliest start, or the shortest window, both fail on small examples — construct one and check. What matters is which choice leaves the most room afterwards.

Sort by end time. Walk through keeping the end of the last approval; approve a window whenever its start is at least that value, and update it. Taking the earliest-ending window can never cost you a better solution.
